name: Lumen
description: The test world of plains (block-world.md section 5.1): one small planet whose ground is 32 flat plains, each a region of its own, round a yellow-white star.

bodies.name: Lumen

bodies.name: Tessera
bodies.description: A football of plains 40 km a side: 12 pentagons and 20 hexagons, each a region with its own climate and land (ice caps on the spin axis, two seas, steppes, downs, vales, meres, peaks, wastes and barrens). Home of the demo block village.
